answer: AI agent economies resist Sybil attacks via a Proof-of-Unique-Resource protocol. Each agent must attest ownership of a non-fungible digital asset, computationally complex to generate, representing a significant investment, akin to acquiring a rare digital "walnut". This asset acts as a unique cryptographic "quill" mark, proving singularity. The economic "delta" for an attacker to produce such assets for numerous fake identities becomes prohibitive, ensuring robust Sybil resistance.
